title: Identity theft - FTC recovery process
facts: IdentityTheft.gov is the Federal Trade Commission's federal resource for reporting identity theft and creating a personal recovery plan.
An Identity Theft Report generated through the FTC process can help document the crime when disputing fraudulent accounts and taking recovery steps.
Identity-theft victims may also need to contact affected companies, credit bureaus, financial institutions, SSA, IRS, or law enforcement depending on what information was misused.
Identity theft involving a Social Security number does not normally mean SSA will automatically issue a new SSN.
